title: Pokémon Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald - Verdanturf Town
description:
The air is tasty here.

This would probably work well in some nice calm town or something? Who knows what you'll do with it.


People with very good ears will probably notice that the reverb on the right-hand piano is slightly different to the original game. I tried to emulate that but it sounded muddy so instead so I used normal echo and stuff - barely any difference though so you'll be fine IMO.
